notes.title: Steam Deck Improvements
notes.content:
- Improved legibility on smaller screens
- Improved rendering performance
- Added setting to disable controller vibration
- While Steam Input is enabled, controllers vibrate indefinitely; while Steam Input is enabled, the controller vibration is automatically disabled

notes.title: Bella Wants Blood is OUT!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!


[b]Bella Wants Blood is OUT[/b]!🩸


As a thank you, there will be a [b]10% discount[/b] going on for the next few day, so don’t miss out!  The game will also be showcased in the [b]Tower Defense fest[/b] starting July, 29th!


Bella Wants Blood is a labor of love from our team. We mixed elements we enjoy from roguelikes and tower defense games to create a fresh experience that we hope you find fun and rewarding. Just don't make Bella mad!


We'd also love for you to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/FCsR7HDQYH]Discord [/url] to chat about the game and share your best runs with the rest of the community.


Thanks for your support and let the blood flow to Bella! 🩸


Mario, Mathias and Michael - Sonderland

notes.title: Bella Wants Blood releases on July 24th
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re excited to announce that [b]BELLA WANTS BLOOD[/b] will release on Steam on [b]July 24th[/b]!

We’ve worked hard in the past months to create a fun and unique experience with the game, mixing things we love about roguelikes and tower defense. We can’t wait for everyone to play with Bella! 🩸

The game will release at a price of [b]$4.99[/b] for which you will get:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037117/94a3ca89a89d5bfa0280deda0a67271235ca5b47.png[/img]

We’ve also just updated the DEMO to the latest version and it is playable in 8 languages, so if you haven’t already, go check that out!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/FCsR7HDQYH]Discord[/url] and share your feedback, suggestions and support us through the release line 🙂

See you at the launch! 🩸

Mario, Michael & Mathias - Sonderland

notes.title: Bite-sized roguelike tower defense game Bella Wants Blood releases July 24
notes.content:
Developer Sonderland (previously worked on Landnama, Core Defense) announced their roguelike tower defense game Bella Wants Blood is going to release on July 24 and it's a perfect coffee-break game. Note: the developer sent over a key, thoughts will be up around release.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/07/bite-sized-roguelike-tower-defense-game-bella-wants-blood-releases-july-24

notes.title: Bella Wants Blood DEMO is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re pumped to be officially revealing [b]Bela Wants Blood[/b] to you! We’ve been hard at work on this absurdly dark TERROR defense game and can’t wait to hear what you think about it.

It’s the second title of our tiny studio and it wouldn’t have been possible without the support of all the people who played Landnama. Since its release last year, we've been itching to get started on our next game and began laying out the concept for Bella Wants Blood.


[previewyoutube=pl3KKcAHPUk;full][/previewyoutube]

Bella Wants Blood is a roguelike TERROR defense game in which you must quench the blood thirst of the child-god entity: BELLA. Lay down gutters and terrors to squash monstrosities to delicious blood for Bella to drink. But don’t let them reach Bella in one piece because they HATE chewing and will grow impatient! 

Choose your path, build destructive mazes and acquire powerful mementos for some extra bite to defeat all of Bella’s friends.

The demo gives you access to the first re-playable level against Stanley, Bella’s hard-shelled friend. So do check it out and come chat with us on Discord to share feedback and ideas!

Stay tuned for more from us soon!

- Mathias, Mario and Michael @ Sonderland
